description: A richly woven dark olive noble tunic with golden interlaced knotwork borders at the neckline, front, cuffs and hem. A broad decorated leather belt with round engraved metal clasp and long ornamented hanging strap secures the waist. A dark green-and-brown checked wool cloak with elaborate knotwork edging and fringed lower edge is draped across the shoulders and fastened by a large round brooch. Brown trousers and brown leather boots with wrap-style straps complete the outfit; no headgear, armor or weapons.
